checkpoint.title: The item's code typed as the 14 box names, then saved: the code save

events.why: Before anything is typed: 0x0351 in Box 3 slot 1 (Lv 100, male), Box 13 slot 7 on and all of Box 14 empty, where the code slides into the box names.
Every box renamed to the code of the run's item (ace_presets.json), a box whose title reads its name already left as it is; each typed name read back from the title.
The code save: 02-trigger starts from it, and a failed trigger goes back to it.

metadata.notes: Run with --options item=<slug> withdraw=<n>. Starts below the Route 4 Pokémon Center's PC, as frlg.ace_setup's 02-write-ace-mail ends, and ends there saved. Typing a box name changes nothing until the trigger runs, so a failed attempt is retried from the start. The code is Sleipnir17's Get any item with the Switch-adjusted exit (docs/design/FRLG-ACE-Execution.md).
